messages:
marta: Heads up — after last night's RBAC refactor deploy, ~40 service accounts in prod were granted Admin unexpectedly. Not a mass-login, looks like mapping logic change.

marta: Quick summary: we changed the SAML attribute preference order in auth-mapper (part of the refactor) and it now prefers `entitlements` over `roles`. Some internal CI service injects an `entitlements` claim containing `all-access` for historical reasons.

marta: Minimal repro logs: 
```
2026-02-12T03:21:10Z INFO auth-mapper: received SAML attrs {"roles": ["ci-runner"], "entitlements": ["all-access"]}
2026-02-12T03:21:10Z INFO rbac: mapped principal service/ci-runner@example.com -> role Admin
```

chris: omg. that `entitlements` carrying `all-access` was always supposed to be ignored for RBAC. we explicitly used `roles` before. Did the refactor flip the order? :eyes:

leo: I see the PR that touched the mapper: https://git.internal/r/redwood/refactor-auth/merge/512 — it replaced the old precedence array with a consolidated attr list. looks like a logic bug: the consolidated list retains source order from Okta which puts `entitlements` first for some app integrations.

marta: exact. reproducer config in prod is basically: 
```yaml
# auth-mapper config (current, buggy)
attribute_priority: ["entitlements","roles","groups"]
mapping:
  "all-access": Admin
  "ci-runner": CI
```

marta: desired config should be: 
```yaml
attribute_priority: ["roles","groups","entitlements"]
```

security-oncall: Priorities: 1) Stop more Admin assignments 2) Audit current granted principals 3) Rollback or hotfix.

chris: I can push a hotfix to flip the attribute_priority and restart auth-mapper in prod. Minimal blast radius. I'll prepare a canary to staging first.

leo: I've started an audit query: `SELECT principal, role, assigned_at FROM rbac_audit WHERE assigned_at > '2026-02-12T00:00:00Z' AND role = 'Admin'` — results coming. Expecting service accounts only but will confirm.

marta: Also: make sure we log the SAML raw assertion for the affected principals (PII redaction allowed) so we can trace which IdP app is setting `entitlements`.

devsec-bot: Deployment queued by chris. ID: deploy-8773. Checks: unit, integ, policy-lint.

security-oncall: If hotfix looks good, we should: A) flip attribute precedence B) run rollback script to re-evaluate RBAC for principals where Admin came from `entitlements` claim and demote to previous role C) create a monitoring alert for unexpected role escalations.

chris: Hotfix plan: PR with config change + small change to auth-mapper to emit debug line when `entitlements` is used to grant a privileged role. Will run canary in staging then prod patch (~10min downtime for auth-mapper restart).

marta: I'll own the rollback script: algorithm = for each principal with Admin assigned after deploy_ts, re-run mapper with corrected precedence and if new role != Admin update rbac and emit audit event.

leo: Audit results: 42 principals, 38 are service accounts (CI/cron), 4 are human users in infra team. I'll DM infra leads about their users.

security-oncall: For compliance: create an incident ticket (INC-2026-084) with timeline and list of affected principals, copy of SAML assertions (redacted), and remediation steps. We need this for SOC2 evidence.

chris: Canary passed in staging. Kicking prod patch now.

devsec-bot: deploy-8773 -> success on canary, started prod rollout.

marta: Patch deployed and auth-mapper restarted at 03:40Z. Running rollback script now.

marta: Rollback script results: 42 evaluated, 40 demoted from Admin to expected roles; 2 required manual follow-up (human infra accounts) — flagged in INC-2026-084.

security-oncall: Good work. Next steps: 1) Add an assertion check in onboarding docs for internal apps not to set `entitlements: all-access` 2) Add unit test in mapper for precedence behaviour 3) Add alert for sudden spike in Admin assignments.

chris: I'll open the PRs and the alert.

leo: I'm adding a follow-up to identity runbook about verifying attribute precedence after any mapper changes.

marta: Closing loop: will attach audit CSV and redacted assertions to the incident ticket, and schedule a 30-min postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:

security-oncall: Thanks team. Please update INC-2026-084 when you have docs/PR links.
